channel.title: Marian Stancik — Blog
channel.description: AI agents, autonomous systems, law & tech, and building in public.

item.title: MCP Goes Stateless: What the 2026-07-28 Specification Means for Autonomous Agents — Marian Stancik
item.description: The Model Context Protocol's biggest revision yet — stateless core, header-based routing, MRTR, OpenTelemetry, and how it changes autonomous agent infrastructure.

item.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems on European Cloud — Marian Stancik
item.description: Architecture, GDPR data sovereignty, and 24/7 orchestration of autonomous agents on European VPS infrastructure.

item.title: Designing Your Local Agent Network for NVIDIA PAIR — Distributed Inference Across Devices — Marian Stancik
item.description: NVIDIA PAIR turns idle home PCs into a distributed inference cluster for AI agents. How to design a local agent network that routes tasks across multiple devices.

item.title: The Convergence of Agent Architectures: Why Everyone Is Building the Same Two-Plane System — Marian Stancik
item.description: NVIDIA AVO, the AOS reference architecture, and the Auton framework all converged on the same architectural pattern: a two-plane design separating governance from execution for production autonomous agents.

item.title: NVIDIA AVO: When Autonomous Agents Run for 7 Days and Beat Expert Engineers — Marian Stancik
item.description: NVIDIA's AVO architecture ran autonomously for 7 days, optimized GPU kernels beyond FlashAttention-4, and scored 100% on ARC-AGI-3. What this means for the future of autonomous agents.

item.title: From Solo Founder to Agent-Driven Company — Marian Stancik
item.description: How I deployed 19 autonomous AI cron jobs on a €3.79/mo VPS for content, CRM, legal monitoring, and system health — all agent-driven.

item.title: Web Performance Optimization: How I Cut Page Size by 61% — Marian Stancik
item.description: A technical walkthrough of reducing HTML page weight from 86KB to 34KB and improving Lighthouse scores by externalizing CSS, JS, and images.

item.title: Building a Digital Twin That Posts 9x Daily — Marian Stancik
item.description: How I automated my personal brand across 6 platforms using Python, cron, and LLM orchestration without sacrificing authenticity.

item.title: AI Act Compliance for Small AI Companies — Marian Stancik
item.description: Practical legal-by-design framework for startups building AI products in the EU. Risk classification, technical documentation, and GDPR compliance.

item.title: Autonomous Drone Missions with ArduPilot & Python — Marian Stancik
item.description: Building a production-grade UAV system with Pixhawk, ArduPilot, and Python-based mission planning for automated multi-waypoint flights.
